Kuki-Zo Council issues ultimatum to Centre over demands

The Kuki-Zo Council has set an October 10 deadline for the Centre and the Manipur government to address their concerns. The council has threatened to launch a 'full-fledged' agitation if their demands are not met by the specified date. The specific nature of these concerns or demands was not detailed in the coverage.
